items.article_summary: Scott Melker discusses North Korea's Lazarus Group exploiting Hyperliquid's lack of controls to launder over $30 million in bitcoin, as Bloomberg reports that Kraken's parent company Payward is trying to bring Hyperliquid products to the US through its CFTC-regulated subsidiary, Bitnomial. " The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker " airs every day at 12:00 p.m. So the reason that this is so interesting is because the day that Bitcoin skyrocketed from the mid 60s all the way to basically 80,000. Well, North Korea's Lazarus group, the largest hackers on this planet of Earth have sold more than 30 million of Bitcoin through Hyperliquid during the past three weeks.
